newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins rise on unchanged U.S. rates.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins rise on unchanged U.S. rates.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds rose in early lively trading on Wednesday after the U.S. Federal Reserve announced late on Tuesday it would not change interest rates, dealers said.
"The Fed did not change rates and buying started from the very beginning of the day," an International Moscow Bank dealer said.
MinFins, along with other emerging debt, are sensitive to any news which would suggest a change in U.S. interest rates and consequently affect U.S. Treasury bond prices.
Dealers said the fifth and fourth MinFin tranches were most actively traded, with local banks seen mainly on the offer side, while Western counterparties buying but not aggressively.
